technical_and_design_decisions: U6 (System Channel Genesis Block): Will be implemented as a separate, dedicated API function (e.g., `CreateSystemChannelGenesisBlock`). This decision prioritizes API clarity and separation of concerns, as per the specification's allowance.

U8 (SigningIdentity Renaming): `CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope` will be renamed to `SignConfigUpdateEnvelope`. The `SigningIdentity` interface will be extended to include a `SignConfigUpdate` method. The `SignConfigUpdateEnvelope` method may be considered for addition to the interface if it enhances usability, but the primary requirement is met by adding `SignConfigUpdate`.

General API Design: All new functions (for retrieval, update, removal, and creation) will follow the existing patterns and style in the `configtx` package to maintain consistency. They will accept relevant parameters (like channel name, organization name, consortium name) and return appropriate values (like `config.Channel`, updated `config.Template`, error).
assumptions: The developer (myself) has a strong understanding of the existing Hyperledger Fabric `configtx` package structure and its internal helpers for config processing.
The core `configtx` library and its dependencies are available and functional in the development environment.

The development work includes writing unit tests and updating example tests (`example_test`) as per the acceptance criteria for each user story. The test development effort is included within each activity's estimate.
The `config.Channel`, `config.Template`, and related types are already defined and can be returned from the new functions.
The effort estimates are for the core logic implementation and associated tests. Effort for broader integration testing, build system changes, or deployment is not included.
Documentation effort (U7, U8) includes writing and integrating the comments into the GoDoc, not just drafting text.

activities.activity_description: Analyze each user story in detail, review the existing codebase to identify integration points, and outline the specific functions, parameters, and return types for all new/modified APIs. Refine technical decisions from the list above.

activities.activity_name: Implement U1: Retrieve Entire Channel Configuration
activities.activity_description: Implement the function (e.g., `RetrieveChannelConfig`) that constructs and returns a `config.Channel` object from the raw config transaction bytes or existing config, leveraging existing helper functions.

activities.activity_name: Implement U2: Update Consortium Channel Creation Policy
activities.activity_description: Implement the function (e.g., `UpdateConsortiumChannelCreationPolicy`) to update the specific `ConfigValue` for the channel creation policy within a consortium group in a config template. Add corresponding example in `example_test`.

activities.activity_name: Implement U3: Add/Remove/Retrieve Channel Group Policies
activities.activity_description: Implement functions for adding (`AddChannelGroupPolicy`), removing (`RemoveChannelGroupPolicy`), and retrieving policies from the top-level channel group. Update examples to demonstrate usage.
Implement separate functions (e.g., `RemoveOrgFromConsortium`, `RemoveAppOrg`, `RemoveOrdererOrg`) to remove an organization from the respective groups in a config template. Update examples.
Implement the function (e.g., `RemoveConsortium`) to remove a specific consortium from the channel config. Update examples.

activities.activity_name: Implement U6: Create System Channel Genesis Block
activities.activity_description: Implement the `CreateSystemChannelGenesisBlock` function. Design the data structures and logic to generate the block containing only the channel group with orderer and consortiums sections, as per the system channel structure.

activities.activity_name: Implement U7: Add Package Overview Documentation
activities.activity_description: Write the GoDoc `Overview` section for the `configtx` package, explaining its purpose, general usage flow for channel creation/update, and briefly describing channel structure (orderer, consortiums, application groups).

activities.activity_name: Implement U8: Extend SigningIdentity and Rename API
activities.activity_description: Rename `CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope` to `SignConfigUpdateEnvelope`. Extend the `SigningIdentity` interface with the `SignConfigUpdate` method. Update the implementation of `SigningIdentity` (e.g., `CryptoSigner`). Update all references and documentation to explain the two signing functions.

activities.activity_name: Develop Unit & Example Tests for U1-U6
activities.activity_description: Write comprehensive unit tests for all new functions implemented in A2-A7. Create or update example tests (`example_test.go`) to demonstrate the usage of each new feature, as specified in the acceptance criteria.

Perform final integration of all changes, ensure all new APIs are consistently exposed, run the full test suite, refactor any duplicated logic, and review all documentation (GoDoc and examples) for accuracy and clarity.
